## What you should be able to do tonight

- Present each signal with its economic rationale stated before any result.
- Show the trial count on the first page and the combination argued for on grounds other than its score.

## Tasks <span class='task-total'>50 min</span>

::: {.task-list}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [30 min]{.task-min} Assemble reports/milestone-06-alpha-book.md: the trial count and threshold on page one, then a generated page per signal with rationale first, then the correlation matrix and effective independent count, then the combination with the argument for why you combined that way rather than the way that scored best, then the signal that does not work with its diagnosis.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [20 min]{.task-min} Verify: regenerate every page from its result object, rerun the test suite, and check the combined result reproduces from the configuration file. Then read the whole document once as a reader who is looking for the place you flattered yourself.
:::

## Drill <span class='task-total'>interview thread</span>

Spaced repetition, not cramming. Every drill in the year is collected on the [drills page](../drills.qmd).

::: {.task-list .drill}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> Arithmetic, timed, twenty-ninth sitting. Ten two-digit multiplications and the sevenths.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> Cross-validation out loud in ninety seconds: what it estimates, why the estimate is biased, and the two distinct reasons standard k-fold is wrong on financial data. You will build the fixes next week, so today is the explanation rather than the method.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> Start the research presentation thread, which runs until July. Write the single sentence that states the most interesting result of your genetics work to someone quantitative who knows no biology. One sentence, out loud, timed. You will rewrite it perhaps twenty times over the next five months.
:::
:::

## The running strategy

::: {.project}
Milestone 6 closes the alpha phase. The book holds eight characterised signals, a measured correlation structure, a defended combination and a corrected verdict, and phase 7 asks whether a nonlinear model can beat it.
:::
